classification.difficultyReason: Calculate total earnings and reverse penalty-rate calculations to find an hourly rate or missing hours.

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Equivalent normal hours}&=1200\div40=30\\\text{Double time hours}&=\frac{30-8-(8\times1.5)}{2}\\\text{Double time hours}&=10\div2\\\text{Double time hours}&=5\text{ h}\end{align*}$$
